citySuggestions.name: London
citySuggestions.blurb: A world-class city with free museums, iconic landmarks, Borough Market, and a legendary pub scene. Good jet-lag day one — but the group leans less on London than the other stops.

citySuggestions.name: Paris
citySuggestions.blurb: The Eiffel Tower, the Louvre, the best bread of your life, and a 2.5-hour Eurostar hop from London. Book Louvre tickets way in advance.

citySuggestions.name: Rome
citySuggestions.blurb: 2,000 years of history in one city — Colosseum, Vatican, Trastevere, and incredible pasta. Vatican tickets must be pre-booked months ahead.

citySuggestions.name: Amsterdam
citySuggestions.blurb: Canals, Rijksmuseum, vibrant food scene, and a great hub for getting around northwest Europe. Jonathan called it out and Sean was immediately on board.

citySuggestions.name: Munich
citySuggestions.blurb: Jonathan's top pick — great beer halls, BMW Museum, day trips to the Alps, and a vibe that's more chill than Berlin. Sean echoed Germany as a solid choice.

citySuggestions.name: Milan
citySuggestions.blurb: Italy's fashion and design capital — the Duomo, the Navigli canals, world-class shopping, and da Vinci's The Last Supper. A buzzing gateway into the Alps.

citySuggestions.name: Interlaken
citySuggestions.blurb: Gateway to the Swiss Alps with stunning mountain views, adventure activities like paragliding and hiking, and a charming small-town vibe nestled between two lakes.

citySuggestions.name: Bologna
citySuggestions.blurb: The culinary heart of Italy — famous for fresh tagliatelle, tortellini, and mortadella. Medieval towers, vibrant piazzas, and some of the best food you'll ever eat.

citySuggestions.name: Zurich
citySuggestions.blurb: Switzerland's largest city — a clean, walkable mix of medieval Altstadt, lakeside promenades, world-class museums, and easy access to ZRH for the flight home.

citySuggestions.name: Ljubljana
citySuggestions.blurb: Slovenia's underrated gem — a compact, car-free Old Town draped along the Ljubljanica River, crowned by a medieval castle. Perfectly positioned between Italy and Switzerland for a one-night stop.
